status: Playable high-resolution character v1: rigged, textured, facial morphs, twelve clips, Godot actor and encounter integration; final campaign and live multiplayer acceptance remain open

visual_reference.description: User's four photographs show Albert Poels' Lange Wapper statue beside Het Steen. Its face, parted bob hair, slender proportions, collar, flared sleeves and belted tunic inform the fictional Antigoon character.
visual_reference.photo_usage: Shape reference only. Photographs and their watermarks are not used as model textures.

appearance.body: Slender living male giant, long limbs, pale skin, golden blond hair, large pale light-blue eyes, dark tunic, faded slate-blue trousers and muddy brown leather shoes.
appearance.weathering: Uneven damp staining and silt concentrate at ankles, knees, tunic hem, cuffs and shoes. Colour, roughness and tangent normals baked to 4K body/head maps; woven cloth detail has colour and relief. Belt has its own 2K PBR set.
appearance.belt: Separate brown leather mesh fitted above the tunic, 190 mm wide and 16 mm thick at giant scale, 3 mm bevelled edges, saddle stitches and hanging strap. The 40 mm wide, 6 mm thick keeper is centred at X=0.260 m, to the right of the hanging end. Its front and back follow the actual belt surfaces so the belt passes through its opening. The approved 230 x 184 mm brass buckle remains centred at X=0 with horizontal tongue and 4 mm edge bevel. Metal uses a constant metallic material; no dedicated corrosion map.
appearance.approval: User approved the blond smirk portrait as perfect. That approval applies to the expression study, not automatically to the later reconstructed mesh.
appearance.collar: Upper tunic rebuilt with a separate folded collar: 12 mm cloth thickness and 5 mm rounded rim at giant scale.
appearance.hands: Both hands retained to follow the supplied statue references; no missing-hand variant yet.
appearance.pose: Editable neutral A-pose with 46-bone deform rig and five facial controls: jaw_open, smirk, angry, blink, laugh.
appearance.back: Inferred from the frontal references and reviewed separately.
appearance.face: Separate eyeballs, radial pale-blue irises, pupils, eyelid rims, teeth, tongue and mouth cavity. Mouth opening follows the curved lip seam; lip colour is baked around that opening.
appearance.materials: Corrected cuff cloth and exposed wrist assignments; baked body/head PBR maps preserve original garment UVs. Explicit wrist skin material prevents cloth-island dilation bleeding onto hands. Iris and eyelid colour use image textures for portable runtime loading.

tools.references: Built-in image_gen tool: full body, then a separate identity-preserving head reference.
tools.geometry: Locally installed Hunyuan3D 2.0 draft and Hunyuan3D 2.1 refinement.
tools.textures: Locally installed Hunyuan3D Paint 2.0, six views, separate body and head atlases.
tools.assembly: Blender 5.2; original sources retained, metric scaling, editable skeletal rig and facial morphs, authored in-place clips, Cycles review.
tools.validation: Native Godot: 46 bones, 12 clips, finite animated poses and 172 surface LODs. 18 brain, 17 event and 28 host checks pass. Real Events panel button and native resident panic were verified; developer-only gating checks cover ordinary nights, saved enemies, investigation rejection and following-night inactivity.

remaining_work: Full authored Ruien map, scripted first-sighting quest sequence and branching campaign are not included.
Live two-client native-town playthrough and broader city spawn/path acceptance remain unverified. The staged native street proof passed; placement refuses routes too small for the giant.
Animation remains a first playable pass, without terrain IK, cloth simulation or ragdoll. Hair is sculpted geometry; automatic source topology limits deformation polish.
Roar/laugh clips have no recorded voice performance.
Exact visual approval of the reconstructed laughing mesh remains with the user; expression concept approval does not automatically approve the model.

delivery.texture_sizes: Body/head 4096px PBR; leather belt 2048px PBR; irises/eyelid rims 1024px albedo; metallic brass and exposed wrist skin use separate materials. Images embedded in GLB and packed in Blender source.
delivery.godot_check: Actual GLB imported in Godot 4.7.2. Isolated arena and staged native street proof passed. No full-city art or live two-client acceptance claimed.

street_event.trigger: Development-only: F8 > Events > Event: Antigoon, or DEV console event antigoon. Stages a fresh giant at 22:00; ordinary nights and saved enemy records never activate him. Encounter ends at dawn or save/load.
street_event.lamps: timed rock throw; persistent outage until next evening at 20:00
street_event.residents: host-controlled panic, occasional pursuit, protected light and home escape, knockdown, stand after 14m separation, home recovery and schedule release
street_event.scope: ordinary outdoor residents; existing actor actions and transport are not preempted
street_event.audio: original runtime synthetic alarm cry; existing Kenney CC0 impact
street_event.lighting: Character and thrown stones use native sky/spill-light/fog. Character normal, roughness and metallic maps are retained; no night emission added.
